routes.label: issuance of a new ordinary passport in Dubai: expected completion 48 hours

note: AED 55 plus 5% VAT (57.75), as GDRFA Dubai lists the service; the game prices the passport as in Dubai. The holder must be in the country. Validity is a lead.

sources.title: GDRFA Dubai (alsaada.gdrfad.gov.ae), Issuance of a New Ordinary Passport
sources.said: This service enables issuing a new passport. ... Fees 55 AED plus VAT (5%) Terms And Conditions 1. The personal photo must be 5.4 x 5.3 cm with a white background and clearly distinguishable facial features. 2. The passport holder's presence in the country. ... Expected Completion Time 48.0 Hour(s)
